architecture.name: SPARSE CROSS-MODAL LANDMARK RETRIEVAL + GLOBAL CONSENSUS + ROBUST MONOTONE TIMING MAP

textModel.name: XLM-RoBERTa-base
textModel.role: CLaMP3 text dependency; not a second retrieval reference

implementationSemantics.audioInput: raw audio is resampled to 24000 Hz mono, split into 5-second non-overlapping windows, and reduced to MERT mean features
implementationSemantics.symbolicInput: MIDI is converted to MTF with --m3_compatible; MusicXML is converted to standard then interleaved ABC
implementationSemantics.audioEncoder: 12-layer 768-wide transformer over MERT features with maximum audio length 128
implementationSemantics.symbolicEncoder: M3 patch encoder with 64-token patches and 512-token maximum sequence length
implementationSemantics.sharedEmbedding: separate audio and symbolic projections into a 768-dimensional shared space
implementationSemantics.globalEmbedding: masked average pooling followed by the modality projection
implementationSemantics.retrievalSimilarity: cosine similarity over global embeddings in the official search example
implementationSemantics.temporalOutput: global retrieval features only; no independently documented event-level alignment output

resourceGate.reason: The one approved CLaMP3 SAAS reference requires approximately 4.06 GB of model weights before PyTorch, tokenizer, cache, and temporary extraction overhead.

frozenProtocol.consensus: weighted monotone candidate-chain consensus over accepted Top-K landmarks
frozenProtocol.outlierMethod: median absolute deviation of landmark residuals
frozenProtocol.timingMap: monotone piecewise-linear score-beat to audio-second map fitted only from accepted anchors
frozenProtocol.ambiguityPolicy: reject regions without a unique, monotone, high-confidence candidate; leave them explicitly unaligned
frozenProtocol.groundTruthUse: ASAP annotations are evaluation-only and are not supplied to retrieval or parameter selection

evaluation.resourceReason: CLaMP3, MERT, and XLM-R weights were not downloaded because the estimated new footprint exceeded the preferred bound. No retrieval or timing result was fabricated.

downstream.reason: The architecture stop rule precedes production-path changes; existing real-shadow downstream evidence remains valid but is not CLaMP3 evidence.

decision.architectureQualification: RESOURCE_BLOCKED_BEFORE_EVALUATION; this is not a measured retrieval-quality failure
decision.firstBlocker: No bounded local evaluation can be run for the sole approved CLaMP3 reference without exceeding the model-footprint limit.

determinism.canonicalization: sorted JSON keys, UTF-8, no runtime/path/timestamp fields; canonicalSha256 excluded from its own digest

verification.rawMediaRetention: no new media or model weights downloaded; source checkout and metadata remained local
